segments.text: Baby Rylan had open heart surgery… inside his mother's womb.
segments.say: Baby Rylan had open heart surgery... inside his mother's womb.

segments.text: Hi, I'm Clara, from Dr Pharmacist.
segments.say: Hi, I'm Clara, from Doctor Pharmacist.
Rylan was only twenty-six weeks along.

segments.text: A tumor called a teratoma was growing on his heart.
Without help, it could have killed him in 1 to 2 weeks.
segments.say: Without help, it could have killed him in one to two weeks.

segments.text: So his doctors and parents made a bold choice:
operate on Rylan in the womb.
Surgeons opened the womb, and removed the tumor from his tiny chest.
He even had his own IV in his hand, to keep him comfortable and still.
segments.say: He even had his own eye-vee in his hand, to keep him comfortable and still.

segments.text: And after surgery? No recovery room.
Rylan went back to the recovery womb.
He healed there for about 10 more weeks, and was born at 36 weeks.
segments.say: He healed there for about ten more weeks, and was born at thirty-six weeks.

segments.text: It was only the second success of its kind in the world.
If we can operate on a baby inside the womb, that baby is a patient.
And a patient is a person, no matter how small.
